audience: Codex users who want a reviewable, user-level routing policy without overwriting unrelated configuration.
oneSentenceValue: An auditable Codex Skill that plans and safely applies a deliberate Sol/Luna/Terra routing policy while keeping runtime acceptance separate from static configuration.
primaryProof: The shipped standard-library payload provides read-only audit and plan modes, atomic apply, backups with SHA-256 manifests, unknown-configuration preservation, and conflict stops.
firstSuccessfulAction: Install through the current Codex Skill Installer and run the read-only audit command before planning or applying any user-level change.

themeSpec.typography: System sans-serif with a compact mono-like metadata rhythm; PingFang SC fallback for Chinese.
themeSpec.shape: 28px outer canvas radius, 16px route-node radius, 2–4px direct strokes.
themeSpec.motif: Explicit routing graph: Sol Max → Luna/Terra, high-risk return to Sol, all paths to acceptance.
themeSpec.composition: Quiet split desktop hero plus a compact stacked mobile route, preserving the same proof and acceptance path.
